contact_edits.before: That would be Carnation, a fairly pointless piece of sexual fantasy, which in turn gives place to Prelude, about a group of bloodthirsty children. This comes off like something out of Second City, a troupe who are always good as horrific kids (cf. the Dungeon Master sketch in their current revue); it's less amusing than the Second Citizens would be, but it probably has higher aspirations. Equilibrium is somewhat restored in Six Years After, which has Smith being touching as a bereaved mother on a cruise, with Gilmour as her oblivious, though apparently well-meaning, husband. It could be a nice dying fall, if it had something more solid to fall from. - The Mansfield Project is at the Factory Studio Theatre until April 13. Call 416-504-9971 for more information.
